g.desc: Continuous torso skin: shoulders, clavicles, ribcage and abdomen. No temporary leotard boundaries. Hidden neck-root, shoulder joints and pelvic overlap remain complete. Local anatomy and skin shading continue across areas exposed by normal motion.

path.desc: Owner body/torso_skin. Complete closed fill from neck-root (438,361) to rounded lower abdomen (439,681); connects neck, arms and pelvis with previously accepted overlap. All hidden reserves are closed skin surfaces, with no contour ink along internal overlap boundaries.

Rendering 4.1: continuous pale peach skin base, sampled from exposed shoulder/chest reference; cool soft anime complexion. Temporary clothing is replaced by the same uninterrupted skin material. Hidden neck, shoulder and abdomen reserves carry the identical base.

Owner body/torso_skin. The complete parent-derived closed silhouette; top neck-root and bottom pelvic arcs are hidden fill closures and must have no final outline. Shoulder sockets retain their rounded hidden ends. Hard geometry edge, softly tapered final stroke; no separate fabric seam.

Final thin soft brown line, middle weight, endpoints tapered; filled skin extends inside. Hard geometry edge, softly tapered final stroke; no separate fabric seam.

Owner body/torso_skin. Self-shadow: left side-plane band between this open inner boundary and closed body left contour; width 9–21 px, warm desaturated shadow; edge softens inward over 7–14 px, continues into shoulder and pelvic reserve; no outline.

Owner body/torso_skin. Self-shadow right side-plane band closed against body outer contour; mostly low-contrast cool rose, inward edge soft over 8–16 px. Continuity matches left with reference asymmetry; no line.

Owner body/torso_skin. Left chest round volume: upper/front light, lower/outer softer shadow. Closed guide for gentle radial light and broad warm lower turn; underlying skin inferred from covered anatomy, no cup or cloth seam; gradient boundaries not final lines.
Owner body/torso_skin. Right chest round volume: upper/front light with a small cool side shadow; smooth counterpart to left. Closed filled gradient region with no hard edge.
Owner body/torso_skin. Observed soft clavicle-underplane shadow, 3–9 px feather, follows visible collarbone; filled warm rose not drawn border. Continuous beneath front hair.
Owner body/torso_skin. Observed right clavicle-underplane shadow; low opacity warm tint, slightly clearer inner edge and broad soft falloff; no neckline.

Owner body/torso_skin. Central self-occlusion valley: near-vertical deepest narrow middle fades toward chest top, broad feather 3–7 px. Region closed between two chest front planes; no clothes boundary.
Owner body/torso_skin. Soft central upper-chest light wedge extending from neck front; feathered skin illumination, no line; primary light from frontal upper left.

Owner body/torso_skin. Caster head front hair left; receiver body/torso_skin. Narrow cool warm-grey contact shadow on skin immediately behind forelock from shoulder into lateral chest; source head group pending specific hair parts. Later independent shadow layer, not self-shading or physical part.

Owner body/torso_skin. Caster head front hair right, receiver body/torso_skin. Thin separate cast-shadow band following forelock contact; softens from shoulder toward tip. Later independent layer following head, retain source extent before receiver clip.

Covered chest/waist is inferred as continuous skin with restrained soft volume, not a garment. Neck, arm and pelvis interface fill remains complete; no dark seam at hidden root/bottom closures.
